description: Genie validation question suite. Each question has a canonical phrasing, alternate phrasings to test consistency, expected SQL pattern, expected answer type, and the semantic asset it should query.

questions.canonical: Which property had the highest total audience in the most recent monthly period?
alternate_phrasings: What property ranked #1 last month?
Show me the top property by audience for the latest month
Which media property had the most viewers last month?
questions.notes: Should return rank=1 for the most recent MONTHLY period, SUMming across all platforms and regions

questions.canonical: What are the top 5 properties by audience share in the US for Q3?
alternate_phrasings: List the top 5 media properties by share in US for Q3
Give me the US top 5 properties by audience share Q3
questions.notes: Returns top 5 for a specific region and period type

questions.canonical: How did property XYZ rank globally in the most recent weekly period?
alternate_phrasings: What was the rank of XYZ property last week globally?
XYZ global ranking last week
questions.notes: Looking up a specific property's rank

questions.canonical: Which properties had an audience share greater than 5% in the last monthly period?
alternate_phrasings: Show properties with >5% share last month
What properties crossed 5 percent audience share recently?
questions.notes: Filter by threshold

questions.canonical: Who were the bottom 10 properties in total audience for the yearly period?
alternate_phrasings: List the 10 lowest ranked properties by audience this year
Bottom 10 properties by viewers yearly
questions.notes: Reverse sort by rank or total_audience

questions.canonical: What is the average total audience for the top 3 properties monthly?
alternate_phrasings: Average audience of top 3 properties last month
Monthly average for top 3 ranked properties
questions.notes: Requires aggregation over a ranked subset

questions.canonical: Did property ABC move up or down in rank this month compared to last month?
alternate_phrasings: Show rank change for ABC property month over month
ABC property ranking trend this month
questions.notes: Requires self-join or window function for previous period

questions.canonical: Which property had the largest jump in audience share this week?
alternate_phrasings: Top share gainer this week
Property with highest audience share increase weekly
questions.notes: Complex trend calculation across weeks

questions.canonical: What is the audience profile breakdown by platform for property XYZ?
alternate_phrasings: Show me platform breakdown for XYZ audience
XYZ audience by platform
questions.notes: Aggregating profiles by platform

questions.canonical: Which region has the highest concentration of mobile users for property ABC?
alternate_phrasings: Top region for ABC mobile users
Where are most ABC mobile viewers located?
questions.notes: Filter by platform and sort by region

questions.canonical: Compare the desktop vs mobile audience for property LMN in Europe.
alternate_phrasings: LMN desktop and mobile audience in Europe
Europe audience split by device for LMN
questions.notes: Filtering on multiple dimensions

questions.canonical: What percentage of property PQR's audience is in Asia?
alternate_phrasings: PQR audience share in Asia
How much of PQR is from Asia?
questions.notes: Calculating percentage of total for a property

questions.canonical: Which platform drives the most audience for property DEF globally?
alternate_phrasings: Top platform for DEF
DEF main audience platform
questions.notes: Group by platform and rank

questions.canonical: List all properties where Smart TV audience exceeds Mobile audience in the US.
alternate_phrasings: US properties with more Smart TV than Mobile viewers
Properties dominant on Smart TV in America
questions.notes: Complex condition comparing platforms within a region

questions.canonical: What is the total audience size for property GHI across all platforms in LATAM?
alternate_phrasings: GHI total viewers in LATAM
LATAM audience for GHI
questions.notes: Sum of audience for property in a region

questions.canonical: Show the regional distribution of Connected TV audience for property JKL.
alternate_phrasings: JKL Connected TV audience by region
Where are JKL's Connected TV viewers?
questions.notes: Group by region with platform filter

questions.canonical: What is the audience overlap index between property ABC and XYZ?
alternate_phrasings: Compare ABC and XYZ audience
Audience index of ABC vs XYZ
questions.notes: Direct pairwise lookup

questions.canonical: Which property has the highest audience index correlation with property LMN?
alternate_phrasings: Properties most similar to LMN by audience
Top audience overlap with LMN
questions.notes: Lookup by property and sort by index

questions.canonical: Are audiences for property DEF and GHI highly correlated (index > 120)?
alternate_phrasings: Is DEF and GHI overlap above 120?
Do DEF and GHI have a high audience index?
questions.notes: Threshold check on pairwise index

questions.canonical: List the top 5 properties with the lowest audience index compared to property PQR.
alternate_phrasings: Properties with least overlap with PQR
Bottom 5 audience index for PQR
questions.notes: Bottom N query for specific property pair

questions.canonical: What is the average audience index between the top 3 network properties?
alternate_phrasings: Average overlap of top 3 networks
Mean audience index among top 3 properties

alternate_phrasings: What property ranked #1 last month?
Show me the top property by audience for the latest month
Which property had the highest total audience in the most recent monthly period?
